in_marathi.name: Nagaraja
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagaraja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nagaraja is a revered deity in Hindu mythology, representing the king of serpents. He is believed to have the power to heal and protect. His name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'naga' meaning serpent and 'raja' meaning king.
